channel.title: Paksh: International

item.description: Applications from foreign students to US colleges saw a 9% rise this fall, with a notable 17% increase originating from India. The number of domestic applicants remained stable. This rebound follows a previous enrollment drop. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.
